_comment: Featured/curated Overton terms that bypass the podcast mention pipeline. These are pinned at the top of the Overton Window with a 'Debated' badge. Pipeline exports cannot overwrite this file.

featured.term: Cleared, no relief (price of duration sponsorship)
featured.thesis: When coupon reopenings clear strong at multi-decade-high yields, the first enlarged long-end buyback fails to bring relief, the 20y softens on cover, and a unanimous Warsh hike still leaves the 10y at ~5% and the 30y near 5.35%, the regime is the price of duration sponsorship — private clearance exists, relief does not. Money is in who warehouses duration at these clearing yields — not Nvidia, not AGI timeline theater.
featured.who_collects_rent: Captive duration absorbers (banks/pensions via HTM/SLR/rules); primary dealers as thin warehouse; Treasury buyback ops as liquidity insurance — franchise ROE / accounting on forced holdings at higher equilibrium yields; dealer fees; state bid as cosmetic backstop. Leftover: soft-landing / Fed-cut coupon narrative.
featured.decisive_test: (1) Nov 4 QRA — buyback maxes cut or framed temporary → RELEGATE. (2) Sustained FRED/Treasury CMT 10y back below ~4.50% with buyback ops idle/undersubscribed → price-of-sponsorship thesis weakens. (3) Sep 15 20y stamped soft (HY 5.420% BTC 2.57 indirects ~52.5%) — sponsorship stress tightens WATCH, not RELEGATE; next long coupons Oct 6–7 3y/10y — soft cover/fat tail/weak indirects with thick buybacks → stress tightens further (WATCH). (4) FOMC+SEP Sep 16 DONE — +25bp to 3.75–4.00% unanimous 12–0; SEP median funds 4.1% YE26/YE27; CMT 9/16 10y 5.01% / 30y 5.35% (10s30s +34bp) sticky longs = regime intact. Live falsifier remains a later long-end rally repairing 10s30s while buybacks go quiet — not the hike itself.
featured.nested_note: Evolution: Buyback as confession → Cleared, no relief (clearance ≠ relief). Auctions: Sep 9 10y HY 4.834% BTC 2.71; Sep 10 30y HY 5.308% BTC 2.61; buyback ~$5.187bn/$6bn; Sep 15 20y HY 5.420% BTC 2.57 indirects ~52.5% ($6.776bn/$13bn) soft vs Sep 9–10. Tape: Treasury CMT 2026-09-16 10y 5.01% / 20y 5.39% / 30y 5.35% (10s30s +34bp) — FOMC-day 10y rose. FOMC: +25 to 3.75–4.00%, 12–0; SEP median 4.1% YE26/27. MOVE 80.73 (as-of Sep 16 market_data). Calendar: Oct 6–7 3y/10y; Nov 4 QRA. Anti-Overton: SV AGI/RSI/orbital-DC room vs duration-supply plumbing. Nest watts/interconnect under Trap #1 — NOT this card's headline. Trap Map Buyback stays WATCH — do not merge cards.
